title: Brightness & Contrast
description: The basic tonal controls for a live source — brightness, contrast, exposure (in stops), gamma and saturation. It runs as one GPU shader pass: the brightness/contrast/exposure/gamma curve is applied per channel, then saturation is mixed around the luminance. Brightness is audio-mappable. Grades the camera, a dropped photo or clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
